Be Part of What’s Next

Bring a Trailer is where passion for cars meets storytelling and community. As a Production Specialist, you’ll play a key role in shaping how standout vehicles are presented to an engaged global audience—guiding sellers from submission to a successful auction experience.

About Hearst Magazines (Why Us?)

Hearst Magazines’ portfolio of more than 30 powerful brands in the U.S. reaches more than 165 million people every month across print, digital, video, and social platforms. The company’s diverse portfolio includes many of the world’s most iconic and trusted media brands, including Cosmopolitan, ELLE, Esquire, Good Housekeeping, Harper’s BAZAAR, Popular Mechanics, and Runner’s World, as well as enthusiast titles like Car and Driver and Road & Track.

Key Responsibilities (What You Are Doing)

  • Prepare auction listings by organizing seller-submitted data and photos in accordance with Bring a Trailer standards
  • Coordinate with sellers and internal teams to incorporate updates and ensure listing accuracy and completeness
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for sellers during the pre-auction phase, delivering timely and professional communication
  • Provide high-quality customer support by answering questions, offering guidance, and addressing concerns with empathy
  • Manage and prioritize a high-volume pipeline of listings at various stages to meet daily production goals
  • Track listings through internal systems and act as the subject matter expert on each listing’s history
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure a smooth transition from listing creation to auction launch
  • Contribute to special projects and process improvements as needed

Qualifications (What We’re Looking For)

  • 2+ years of experience in customer support, content production, technical writing, automotive services, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong writing and editing skills with an ability to present detailed information clearly and accurately
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with a customer-first mindset and a professional, approachable communication style
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and build trust with stakeholders
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate challenges independently while knowing when to escalate
  • Interest in or knowledge of collector cars and automotive culture; hands-on automotive experience is a plus
  • Adaptable, proactive, and eager to support evolving team and business needs

This is a full-time position that can be done remotely. Please note that we can only consider applicants from the following states: CA, CO, DE, FL, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, NC, NY, OH, PA, RI, TX, VA, WA, WI.

Benefits (What We Offer)

  • Work with the Best: Collaborate with top-tier professionals across media, advertising, tech, fashion, lifestyle, and publishing, shaping the future of these dynamic industries.
  • Grow Your Skills: Unlock your potential with access to innovative training programs, immersive workshops, and exclusive industry events.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid work, empowering you to balance professional success with personal priorities.
  • Foster Connection & Belonging: Join our Employee Resource Groups and help create a welcoming workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered.
  • Wellness First: Prioritize your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance from Day 1.
  • Plan for Your Financial Future: Enjoy competitive financial perks, including a 401(k) plan with a generous company match.

The base salary for this role is $66,000-$70,000. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as: transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hearst Magazines is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The Opportunity

AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.

Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still operate with many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.

BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.

The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.

We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.

Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes — calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved — not on how much software they configure themselves.

Our AI workforce starts with two teammates:

Ava — AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.

Claire — AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.

Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.

They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice — including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles — all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the technology and deployment infrastructure are being built for scale.

What remains is to complete the founding team with a commercial co-founder — someone who will own revenue and go-to-market with the same conviction, urgency, and sense of ownership as the CEO and CTO.

This is not a role where you inherit a sales team, a mature playbook, and a predictable funnel. You will help discover and build those things.

You will personally close early customers, determine which channels scale, refine the commercial model from real market evidence, and then build the organization capable of repeating it.

This is a co-founder and leadership role, not simply a sales hire. You will join the CEO and CTO as one of three co-founders, with founder-level equity, founder-level responsibility, and a meaningful voice in go-to-market, pricing, hiring, fundraising, product direction, and company strategy.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CRO, you will own the commercial journey from first conversation through acquisition, retention, and expansion.

  • Early Revenue — Personally convert pilots and prospects into paying customers and establish the first repeatable sales motion across solo practitioners and firms of up to five lawyers.

  • Go-to-Market — Refine and operationalize our ICP, positioning, messaging, and Rise of the Solo narrative, turning them into outreach, demos, pipeline, and closed revenue.

  • Pipeline & Channels — Determine which acquisition channels actually work — outbound, content, paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, communities, events, and others — and concentrate resources behind the ones that can scale.

  • Partnerships & Distribution — Build relationships with legal business coaches, bar associations, legal communities, consultants, complementary technology providers, and other potential distribution partners.

  • Pricing & Commercial Economics — Own pricing, packaging, expansion strategy, customer acquisition economics, retention targets, and the path toward increasing revenue per firm as the AI workforce expands.

  • Customer Success & Retention — Stay close to early customers, understand why they buy and why they stay, and build the commercial processes that turn adoption into retention, expansion, referrals, and advocacy.

  • Customer Proof — Turn early wins into measurable case studies, testimonials, references, and commercial proof around the outcomes lawyers care about.

  • Fundraising — Help tell the growth story to investors through credible traction, metrics, unit economics, forecasts, and a clear path to scale.

  • Team — Once the motion is working, recruit and lead the sales, partnerships, and customer-success organization needed to scale it.

Co-Founder Profile

We're looking for a builder first and a sales executive second.

You are likely someone who has spent enough time inside an established company to know how a professional revenue organization works — but would rather build one than inherit one.

You should bring:

  • A strong record of full-cycle selling, ideally into the legal market or another fragmented SMB/professional-services vertical.

  • The confidence to personally prospect, run demos, negotiate, close, onboard, and expand early customers before hiring people to do it for you.

  • A strong understanding of how small-business buyers make decisions, what creates trust, and how to turn an early-stage product into a compelling commercial proposition.

  • Ideally, an existing network within legal technology, solo and small-firm legal communities, bar associations, legal services, or adjacent channels.

  • Strong commercial judgment — including the willingness to challenge assumptions about positioning, pricing, channels, or markets when the evidence says we should.

  • Entrepreneurial drive: you are ready to move from selling someone else's company to building one of your own.

  • Comfort with an early-stage compensation model weighted heavily toward ownership and revenue creation rather than a conventional executive salary.

  • The ability to operate as a principal, not an employee — making decisions with the long-term value of the company in mind and doing whatever work is necessary at this stage to move it forward.

Early-stage go-to-market leadership, experience selling AI or automation products, and experience selling into the legal profession are strongly preferred. Candidates should be able to operate effectively across North American time zones.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

About the Role

Retail is where COROS meets athletes in person, and across Europe it is the channel with the most room to grow and the one we are investing in now. The Retail Marketing Manager Europe turns that potential into presence, owning the marketing layer on top of our distributor and retail partner relationships across the continent. That covers digital and physical campaigns and activations, point-of-sale displays, shop windows, in-store presence and retail marketing materials, designed, sourced, produced and brought to life in five direct markets plus our distributor-led territories.

The role is also the internal interface for European leadership and sales: Country Managers and Sales Managers bring their market needs here, and this role turns them into briefs, materials and campaigns, working directly with our headquarters teams and with our US counterparts as peers. The operating principle is to build centrally and roll out locally. This role designs the European solution (concept, materials and a ready-to-use execution toolkit), and the country teams, led by the Sales Managers, run the local rollout with this role as central support. The role reports directly to the Head of Europe.

Your playground

  • Develop and execute marketing activations and campaigns with retailers and partners across Europe, in both digital and physical channels.

  • Own the marketing layer of our partner relationships: in-store presence, shop window concepts, point-of-sale displays, retail campaign mechanics and co-marketing execution.

  • Act as the single point of contact for Country Managers and Sales Managers on retail marketing needs: translate market requirements into briefs and ready-to-use toolkits, hand them to the country teams for local rollout, and keep visibility of the pipeline across all markets.

  • Brief and manage POS and display design, source and commission suppliers, manage production timelines, and coordinate distribution and stock of retail materials across European markets.

  • Localise and adapt global assets where they exist, and develop European solutions where they don't.

  • Project manage the European rollout of product launches, working between the European sales organisation and the global brand team so retail and partner execution is ready on time.

  • Design the shop staff engagement programme (product knowledge, training formats and incentive thinking) and hand it to the market teams to run with their retail partners.

  • Develop community-facing activation formats, such as community runs, where they serve retail and partner objectives.

  • Prepare and facilitate the recurring European retail review with the Head of Europe and the Country Managers, where the pipeline is prioritised across markets.

  • Work with the retail and events function in the US as a peer, and engage directly with the headquarters teams in China on asset and material requirements.

  • Track performance across retail presence and activation effectiveness, and use the data to decide where effort and spend go next.

  • Make independent spending decisions within approved projects, and bring opportunities forward proactively rather than waiting for direction.

What you bring to the starting line

Professional Background

  • Experience: 5 years+ in retail marketing, trade marketing or brand activation, ideally in sports, outdoor, consumer electronics or a comparable branded goods environment.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • Retail Execution: Proven track record of bringing a brand to life at the point of sale (POS concepts, in-store presence, retail campaigns) with measurable results.

  • Production and Sourcing: Hands-on experience briefing design, commissioning suppliers, managing production timelines and getting physical material where it needs to be, on time and on budget.

  • Multi-Market Work: Experience working across several time zones, cultures and markets with differing needs, and comfort as the connecting point between commercial stakeholders with varying priorities.

  • Launch Management: Experience running the marketing side of product launches across channels and markets.

Other Key Requirements

  • Collaboration and Organization: Strong project management, excellent communication, and the ability to keep many parallel workstreams moving without losing the detail.

  • Mindset: Self-motivated and resourceful. You propose rather than wait.

  • Language: Fluency in English, spoken and written. An additional European language is a plus.

  • Mobility: Willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

  • Flexibility: Willingness to occasionally work evenings or weekends around activations and events, with time off in lieu.

How the role will grow

COROS Europe is growing fast, and this role is built to grow with it. As individual markets develop enough retail volume to justify their own dedicated retail resource, the scope of this role is likely to shift: less breadth across markets, more depth in the ones that remain. How that plays out will depend on how the business develops and on the strengths the person in this role brings. This is a function being built rather than inherited, and the person building it will shape what it becomes.

The Setup

  • Reporting Line: Head of Europe.

  • Scope: Five direct European markets plus distributor-led territories.

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in the EU or the UK, ideally close to a major airport. Wherever you're based, we'll set you up with a local employment contract.

  • Working Mode: Fully remote or hybrid if you live close to an office location, with occasional team get-togethers.

  • Job Type: Full-time.

Package & Benefits

  • Work in a motivated, international team.

  • Build a function from the ground up in the channel with the most room to grow.

  • Space for ideas and independent work.

  • Flat hierarchy with short decision-making processes.

  • 25 days of paid vacation plus standard local holidays.

  • COROS products and discounts for family & friends.

  • Compensation: The base salary range for this position starts at €55.000,- annually with the possibility to earn a performance-based bonus on top. This is the least we can do for you. The final offer depends on your experience, background, and location.

The Workday Compensation Configuration Lead serves as the enterprise subject matter expert for Workday Compensation and related Total Rewards technology solutions. This role partners with Compensation, HR, Finance, Payroll, and Technology stakeholders to design, configure, implement, and optimize scalable compensation solutions that support business objectives, regulatory requirements, and the associate experience. The Lead provides strategic guidance on Workday capabilities, compensation processes, and leading practices while advising senior leaders on enterprise initiatives, governance, and technology investments that maximize the value of the organization's Workday platform.

The Workday Compensation Configuration Lead is responsible for leading the strategy, design, configuration, testing, implementation, and ongoing support of Workday Compensation solutions. This role serves as the functional owner for compensation-related processes including annual compensation planning, incentive and bonus programs, compensation eligibility, salary structures, market adjustments, one-time payments, and compensation statements. The Lead evaluates business requirements, provides solution recommendations, and translates complex compensation needs into sustainable system capabilities.

Working as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders, this role drives continuous improvement, identifies opportunities for automation and process optimization, and evaluates new Workday functionality to maximize business value. The Lead leads complex initiatives, assesses cross-functional impacts, supports governance and release management activities, and provides advanced troubleshooting for critical production issues.

As a senior subject matter expert, the role influences enterprise strategy, mentors team members, and provides recommendations to leadership on matters with significant operational, financial, compliance, and associate experience impacts.

  • Deep expertise in Workday Advanced Compensation and compensation administration with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, sustainable solutions.
  • Strong strategic consulting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence decisions and provide recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and solution tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives, balance competing priorities, and drive continuous improvement through governance, automation, and optimization
  • Proven ability to provide strategic recommendations, influence business decisions, and lead complex projects or workstreams in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Experience partnering with Compensation, Total Rewards, HR, Finance, Payroll, Technology, and other business stakeholders to deliver enterprise-wide solutions.

What You Will Do

The Senior Manager, SAP ERP Transformation - Plan to Sustain (Field Service Management & Integration) is a critical leadership role responsible for driving the design, development, integration, and deployment of enterprise Field Service Management (FSM) processes and capabilities within RTX’s SAP S/4HANA transformation.


This position will lead the standardization and integration of Field Service Management capabilities across RTX business units, including Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon. The role requires strategic leadership, strong knowledge of field service operations, SAP ERP implementation methodologies, and the ability to align business requirements with enterprise technology solutions. The Senior Manager will collaborate with business and digital technology leaders to establish standardized field service processes, enable system integration, and support operational efficiency across the enterprise.


  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise Field Service Management processes and capabilities within the SAP S/4HANA Plan to Sustain transformation.
  • Develop and manage project plans, timelines, deliverables, and resources associated with Field Service Management process development, system integration, and deployment.
  • Define and standardize end-to-end Field Service Management processes, including service requests, work order management, technician scheduling and dispatch, field service execution, service confirmation, and service order completion.
  • Ensure seamless integration of Field Service Management processes with SAP S/4HANA and supporting enterprise applications, including service management, maintenance, inventory, procurement, finance, and customer service.

  • Collaborate with Digital Technology, system integrators, and cross-functional process teams to define functional requirements, integration points, and solution design specifications.
  • Provide leadership and oversight of Field Service Management solution development, configuration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with Field Service Management process changes, system integrations, data dependencies, and operational transitions.
  • Communicate project progress, key decisions, risks, and strategic recommendations to vice presidents, senior leaders, and business stakeholders.
  • Lead organizational change management activities to support adoption of standardized Field Service Management processes, technology solutions, and operating procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to improve technician productivity, service execution efficiency, resource utilization, and operational visibility through SAP S/4HANA and integrated Field Service Management technologies.
  • Manage relationships with system integrators, technology providers, and implementation partners to ensure quality, accountability, and timely solution delivery.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to Field Service Management performance, including service response times, first-time fix rates, work order completion, technician utilization, and service execution efficiency.
  • Support enterprise governance, process documentation, and solution standardization to ensure consistency, compliance, and alignment with RTX transformation objectives.
  • Mentor and develop team members while promoting collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the Plan to Sustain organization.
  • Ability to travel up to 30%.

What You Will Learn

  • As part of the Plan to Sustain organization, the Senior Manager, Field Service Management & Integration will play a key leadership role in RTX’s enterprise SAP S/4HANA transformation, supporting the modernization and standardization of field service operations across Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon.
  • The role provides the opportunity to lead complex business transformation initiatives involving field service execution, technician scheduling, service order management, and integration with enterprise ERP capabilities. Responsibilities include establishing standardized business processes, defining solution requirements, managing implementation deliverables, and supporting successful deployment across multiple business units.
  • The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Digital Technology, Aftermarket, Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul (MRO), supply chain, finance, operations, and customer service, to ensure Field Service Management capabilities align with enterprise objectives and operational requirements.
  • This position requires the ability to evaluate existing business processes, identify opportunities for standardization, and translate operational requirements into scalable technology solutions. Strong leadership, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and problem-solving skills will be essential to navigating complex integrations and driving successful business outcomes.
  • The Senior Manager will also have the opportunity to develop team capabilities, influence enterprise process decisions, and provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership while supporting RTX’s long-term digital transformation objectives.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of 14 years of prior relevant experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field and a minimum of 12 years of experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Field Service Management, Aftermarket operations, service delivery, ERP systems, or related business transformation initiatives, with expertise in leading large-scale ERP implementations and enterprise system integrations.
  • Experience with Field Service Management processes, including service order management, technician scheduling, dispatch, field service execution, and service completion.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with stakeholders such as Digital Technology and business operations, to define requirements, deliver integrated enterprise solutions, and influence senior executives and stakeholders effectively.
  • Experience in conflict resolution, stakeholder management, and performance management.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Proven expertise in implementing SAP S/4HANA Service Management, SAP Field Service Management, or comparable enterprise Field Service Management solutions, with integration capabilities for ERP, CRM, inventory management, and finance systems.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA processes, including service order processing, service contracts, service execution, maintenance, and logistics, combined with familiarity with SAP implementation methodologies such as SAP Activate and Agile delivery.

We are building somethingEPIC.

Evestia Clinical is a biotech-focused global CRO delivering authentic expertise and personalized support where client need it most.

Our foundation is built on four core principles: Innovation drives us to seek new solutions, Excellence defines the high standards we keep, and genuine Care ensures a supportive culture for both our patients and our people. We foster Partnership in everything we do, believing that working together—with trust and flexibility—is the key to success.

Our approach is agile by nature and personalized by design. This translates to a workplace where you are empowered to find the creative solutions necessary for our collective success. We offer a welcoming, flexible, and supportive culture that values trust and belonging, ensuring you have the support needed to grow your skills and thrive while making a difference. We partner with our clients to provide expert knowledge and guidance through complex clinical trials in rare disease, oncology, neurology, immunology, and inflammation. At Evestia Clinical, you will become a vital part of a global specialist CRO. This means you will deliver life changing impact through clinical excellence.

We are committed to creating development opportunities that allow your skills to grow right alongside ours. If you are inspired by this collaborative environment and ready to change the lives of patients worldwide, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Pharmacovigilance Physician to provide medical leadership and expert oversight of safety data across investigational and marketed products. In this role, you will be responsible for the medical review and assessment of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs), proactive signal detection and evaluation, and the review of periodic aggregate safety reports, including PBRERs and PSURs.

You will also work closely with our Medical Affairs team, providing specialist medical input and supporting the clinical medical monitoring team. This position offers the opportunity to contribute across both pharmacovigilance and broader clinical functions, helping to ensure the ongoing safety and benefit-risk assessment of the products we support.

What will your job look like?

Pharmacovigilance & Safety Operations

  • Perform robust medical review of ICSRs from clinical trials and post-marketing projects, ensuring accurate assessment of seriousness, causality, and expectedness/labeledness.

  • Review and ensure the medical accuracy and appropriateness of MedDRA and WHO Drug coding for adverse events and concomitant medications.

  • Author scientifically valid medical assessments, company comments, and concise medical summaries for complex or serious reported events.

  • Author safety-related queries to investigative sites or reporters to ensure complete and accurate clinical data collection.

  • Review and contribute to cumulative analyses of similar adverse events to support regulatory reporting and safety evaluations, including Analysis of Similar Events (AOSE) where applicable.

  • Provide medical support, guidance, mentoring, and training to the PV team, as required.

  • Review scientific literature to identify potential safety signals or valid ICSRs.

  • Apply sound medical judgment and clinical expertise to provide advice, data interpretations, and strategic guidance to PV and other internal functional departments, clients, and external partners.

  • Provide medical input for responses to regulatory authority requests, inspections, and sponsor audits and safety inquiries

Aggregate Reporting & Signal Management

  • Provide crucial medical input, review, and approval for periodic post-market and clinical safety reports, including PBRERs, PSURs, and DSURs.

  • Participate in active and routine signal detection activities. Evaluate potential safety signals, review safety data trends, and contribute to signal validation and assessment reports.

  • Contribute to integrated benefit-risk assessments throughout the product lifecycle and provide medical interpretation of evolving safety profiles.

  • Participate in or present safety data at internal Safety Management Committees (SMCs) or Data Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs) or sponsor safety governance meetings as contracted, providing medical interpretation, clinical context, and recommendations to support informed safety decision-making.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and provide medical input for Safety Management Plans (SMPs).

  • Provide flexible, occasional support to the clinical medical monitoring function to ensure project continuity during peak workloads or team absences.

  • When supporting clinical operations, assist in responding to site investigators regarding protocol eligibility, safety concerns, and data management queries.

  • Perform ad-hoc medical review of clinical trial data listings, laboratory reports, and subject profiles to ensure medical accuracy and identify potential safety concerns.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

Ensure all pharmacovigilance and medical monitoring activities comply with applicable global regulations (e.g., ICH-GVP, ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA), SOPs, and client requirements

Education:

  • Primary medical degree (e.g., MD, MBBS, MBChB, DO or equivalent) from an accredited medical school is required.

  • Active or previously held medical license/registration is required.

Experience:

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience as a physician in the pharmaceutical industry or a CRO, with a primary focus on Pharmacovigilance and Drug Safety.

  • Proven, hands-on experience performing medical review of ICSRs.

  • Experience with aggregate safety report (PBRERs, PSURs, DSURs) review and generation is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of global regulations regarding drug safety and pharmacovigilance (ICH, FDA, EMA).

  • Strong scientific, clinical, and analytical knowledge with excellent ability to read, analyze, and interpret scientific data.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret complex scientific and clinical data.

Competencies & Skills

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with Investigators, clients, and regulatory authorities.

  • Highly proficient in utilizing electronic applications, specifically the ability to efficiently navigate clinical and pharmacovigilance safety databases to conduct medical reviews and extract data.

  • Ability to exercise independent medical judgment and make timely, evidence-based decisions in time-sensitive situations, including complex safety assessments, benefit-risk evaluation, signal management, and clinical trial eligibility support when required.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams and with external stakeholders.

  • Strong knowledge of MedDRA and WHO Drug coding dictionaries.

What we offer you in return?

We believe that to do your best work, you need the best support. That's why we care deeply about your wellbeing, personal development, and achieving a true work-life balance.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to influence patient safety on a global scale while working with talented colleagues who share a passion for scientific excellence. We offer a collaborative and flexible working environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to contribute to meaningful work that ultimately benefits patients around the world.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

Does joining Evestia Clinical and making a global impact excite you? Then it's time to apply!

We are eager to meet ambitious candidates. Remember, we hire for potential and passion. Therefore if you feel you're a good fit but don't meet every single requirement, please submit your application anyway. We want to hear from you.

How You’ll Drive Success

Payroll Processing & Administration

Payroll Accounting & Financial Support

  • Reconcile payroll registers to control schedules, funding reports, general ledger interface files, and payroll-related general ledger accounts.
  • Provide month-end, year-end, audit, tax, retirement plan, and benefit-related payroll support.

Reporting, Analysis & Process Improvement

At Stearns Bank, we’re helping people, entrepreneurs, small businesses, and local communities nationwide reach their full financial potential. Sound like something you want to be a part of? If so, we’re currently looking for a Commercial Lender This position is a Connected Mobile Work Environment position.

Come see how we’re doing business unusual and charting our own path to reimagine a more inclusive financial services and banking ecosystem for all.

BENEFITS

Stearns Bank understands and respects that everyone is managing unique career, family, and wellness needs. That’s why we offer industry-leading benefits to employees to help them live healthy lives and bring their full selves to work every day. Benefits may vary for part-time positions. Some of those benefits include:

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan & 401k Plan
  • Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision, Telehealth, Life insurance)
  • 12-week Paid Parental Leave and Medical Leave: With a cap of 20 weeks for eligible team members who qualify for both Medical and Parental Leave related to the birth of a child
  • $5,000 Family Care Reimbursement: Childcare, Elder Care, Student Loan Debt, Pet expenses, Down Payment Assistance, Health Insurance Premiums
  • PTO from 13 to 23 days depending on tenure. Cashout and Carryover options
  • 10 Days Sick Time
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • 4 Days Volunteer Time
  • 2 Days Self Allowance Time
  • Tuition Assistance

For this position, we anticipate an annual salary between $140,000 – 175,000 Final employment offers will be dependent upon the selected candidate’s relevant qualifications and experience.

JOB SUMMARY

Develop and manage lending relationships for the purpose of generating loan requests that meet established lending requirements, which provide maximum profitability to the bank with a minimum risk. Including managing a loan portfolio for the express purpose of increasing balances and profit, and decreasing past dues, charge-offs, and other loan problems. Ability to work within the bank’s national lending platform under various programs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop an on-going personal business development plan that utilizes a structured calling program that generates an agreed-to minimum of new loan growth and fee generation based on business unit KPIs.
  • Collect necessary information from loan applicants so that loan requests can be understood and properly underwritten; respond to the credit department’s questions pertaining to the underwriting process to determine the credit worthiness of loan applicants.
  • Will provide information as requested on status of loans in process and approved but not closed (pipeline and backlog report).
  • Make timely decisions on loan applications within granted authorities.
  • Is responsible for the accuracy of loan grading, documentation, performance, clearing of exceptions, and follow-up on all loans in assigned portfolio.
  • Will actively work existing customer base for referrals that garners new business from prospects and existing customers alike.
  • Maintain a list of delinquent accounts within the personal portfolio and maintain a log of collection efforts. Contact delinquent accounts via telephone, personal visits or correspondence. Forward irreconcilable accounts for collector action or pursuing legal action.
  • Monitor loan repayment for loans in assigned portfolio and take necessary action to collect past due loans.
  • Participate in community activities for the purpose of increasing the bank’s visibility and seeking out new business opportunities.
  • Promote bank services, seek out referral opportunities (including consumer loans), answer customer questions, and direct customers to the appropriate personnel for assistance.
  • Effectively use bank systems and other technology to the fullest extent of their capabilities to include lead tracking, opportunities, file notes, underwriting, processing, closings, and servicing workflows.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of all legal and regulatory compliance issues as they pertain to this position.
  • Loss prevention and security as applicable to this position.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 lbs.
  • Ability to understand and follow instructions in English.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods of time, twist, bend, sit, walk use hands to twist, handle or feel objects, tools or controls, such as computer mouse, computer keyboard, calculator, stapler, telephone, staple puller, etc., reach with hands and arms, balance, stoop, kneel, talk or hear.
  • Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university preferred but will consider experience in lieu of degree.
  • Proven track record in commercial lending, specifically for commercial and commercial real estate loan requests.
  • Relationship management skills for commercial, small business, and personal relationships.
  • Highly developed analytical and underwriting expertise and a credit quality focus.
  • Portfolio management experience required.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Proficient computer skills.
  • Excellent customer service skills.

THE COMPANY

Founded in 1912, Stearns Financial Services Inc. (SFSI) is a $3.2 billion, independently owned financial institution with locations in Minnesota, Florida and Arizona, and over 35,000 small business customers nationwide. Specializing in affordable housing financing, USDA and SBA lending, and small business and equipment financing, Stearns Bank is regularly recognized as one of the country’s top-performing banks and “Best Banks to Work For” by American Banker.

As a Star Tribune Top Workplaces award recipient and an award recipient of the Minnesota Business Magazine 100 Best Places to Work in Minnesota, Stearns takes pride in their team and holds their employees in extremely high regard. We offer a competitive salary and benefit package including our Employee Stock Ownership Program-one of the best long-term incentive programs in the nation. To learn more about Stearns Bank, visit www. StearnsBank.com

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER /AFFIRMATIVE ACTION PLAN

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, or creed, religion, sex, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran’s status, status with regard to public assistance, or any other class protected by Federal, State, local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

      <title>Databricks: Deployment Strategist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - India
</p>

<h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2>
<p>The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering <em>outcomes</em>, not just a platform.</p>
<p>You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."</p>
<h2><strong>Role Description</strong></h2>
<p>As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.</p>
<p>You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.</p>
<p>This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.</p>
<h2><strong>The impact you will have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>C-Suite Scoping &amp; Value Definition:</strong> Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.</li>
<li><strong>End-to-End Product Ownership:</strong> Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Solution Leadership</strong><strong> &amp; Delivery:</strong> Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.</li>
<li><strong>Solution Launch &amp; Landing:</strong> Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic Handoff &amp; Growth:</strong> Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What we look for</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Executive Presence &amp; Communication:</strong> You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Product Judgment &amp; Delivery:</strong> You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Fluency &amp; Architecture Judgment:</strong> You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on Technical Ability:</strong> You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.</li>
<li><strong>Relevant Experience:</strong> Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p>
<p><span>Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p>
<p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p>
<p><strong>Compliance</strong></p>
<p><strong><span>If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div>

</description>

      <title>Vercel: Software Engineer - Data Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2>About Vercel:</h2>
<p><span>Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.</span></p>
<p><span>Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.</span></p></div><h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>We're looking for a Staff level Engineer to lead the design and development of a next-generation Data Platform at Vercel. This is a unique opportunity to architect a foundational system that will power data across our products and business, supporting everything from real-time analytics to AI/ML initiatives.</p>
<p>Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data Engineering, you'll define the technical vision for our data ecosystem, work across the organization to align engineering strategy with product goals, and build scalable, reliable systems using modern technologies like Kafka, ClickHouse, Tinybird, and Snowflake.</p>
<p>You'll lead from the front, writing production-grade code, setting high standards for design and data governance, and mentoring a team of engineers as the organization grows. If you're excited by the challenge of building scalable data systems that drive product innovation, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Design and implement a next-generation data platform that supports diverse requirements, including batch and real-time integrations, advanced analytics, and multiple data types, leveraging Kafka, Kafka-based tooling, and additional streaming technologies to power real-time data movement and processing.</li>
<li>Work with engineering, product, and senior leadership teams across Vercel to architect solutions that address business needs, aligning technical strategies with product goals and ensuring seamless data availability and usability.</li>
<li>Define and maintain guidelines for data ingestion, creation, enrichment, and storage, while overseeing data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing (ClickHouse, Tinybird, Snowflake) to achieve low-latency analytics and scalable storage.</li>
<li>Develop end-to-end solutions across the tech stack, setting the example for engineering excellence, and provide mentorship and direction that fosters continuous improvement and innovation in the team.</li>
<li>Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure adherence to data protection standards, and champion high availability and fault tolerance through comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.</li>
<li>Drive architectural decisions and roadmap planning that ensure efficiency, scalability, and high performance, and evaluate build-vs-buy trade-offs, integrating vendor solutions where appropriate.</li>
<li>Collaborate with data scientists and machine learning teams to evolve infrastructure that supports advanced analytics and AI initiatives, serving as a key contributor to strategy, tooling, and platform enhancements for ML-related workloads.</li>
<li>Act as a key decision-maker for discovering, vetting, and selecting data architectures and technologies critical to Vercel's success, and establish multi-phase strategic roadmaps that align with overall business objectives and drive data platform maturity.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About You</h2>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles, with at least 5 years at the Principal Engineer level.</li>
<li>Proven track record designing and operating large-scale data infrastructures at high scale in a complex, fast-paced environment, with experience across Kafka and its ecosystem (e.g., Kafka Streams, Confluent Platform), ClickHouse, Tinybird, Snowflake, and broader big data frameworks.</li>
<li>Proficiency in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and associated big data services.</li>
<li>Strong background in data governance and security, and adept at ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and protecting sensitive information.</li>
<li>Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across varying organizational levels.</li>
<li>A leadership mindset, with demonstrated ability to mentor teams, drive consensus, and advocate for best practices across the organization.</li>
<li>A Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.</li>
<li>Industry recognition or notable contributions in data engineering (e.g., published works, open-source contributions) is a plus.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</h2>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation package, including equity.</li>
<li>Inclusive Healthcare Package.</li>
<li>Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.</li>
<li>Flexible Time Off.</li>
<li>We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.</li>
</ul>
<p>The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $232,000 - $348,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.</p>

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.</li>

      <title>Maven Clinic: Client Success Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com</p>
<p><strong>An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –&nbsp; Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)</li>
<li>Fortune Change the World (2024)</li>
<li>CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)</li>
<li>Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
</ul></div><p>Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our employer accounts.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for employer accounts introduced through Maven’s channel partnerships - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness.&nbsp; You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role,&nbsp; it’s a commercial position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen. This person will be on the front lines as a trusted advisor to our clients and a key partner to our channel partnership teams.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>As Client Success Manager at Maven, you will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Support the success and satisfaction of your portfolio of employer clients, helping ensure strong client retention and engagement&nbsp;</li>
<li>Collaborate with channel/payer partner client executives to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio</li>
<li>Assist in building and maintaining account plans, tracking renewal milestones, and identifying opportunities for growth.</li>
<li>Monitor client health and engagement on an ongoing basis, flagging potential risks early and collaborating with your manager and team to develop mitigation plans.</li>
<li>Identify potential opportunities for client expansion and collaborate with Sales to build business cases and handoffs.</li>
<li>Partner with Sales and Renewals teams to ensure smooth account transitions and handoffs, contributing to clear narratives and data-supported recommendations.</li>
<li>Support client enrollment and engagement initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes, such as employee utilization, satisfaction, or program adoption.</li>
<li>Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews and other client-facing presentations, sharing data insights and supporting renewal or expansion discussions.</li>
<li>Consult clients on program optimization using Maven’s expertise, benchmark data, and program resources, ensuring measurable business impact.</li>
<li>Maintain strong client relationships, fostering satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy, and supporting case studies or success stories where appropriate.</li>
<li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, analytics, marketing) to support client projects, timelines, and deliverables.</li>
<li>Manage client inquiries, issues, and escalations, coordinating with partner teams as needed to resolve challenges.</li>
<li>Share client insights internally to help improve products, processes, and marketing initiatives.</li>
<li>Recommend improvements to client workflows or processes, supporting scalable solutions to enhance outcomes.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for you to bring:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services within digital health, healthcare, benefits, or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and contribute to commercial outcomes.</li>
<li>Experience working with enterprise employer clients through channel/payer partners (5,000+ employees) preferred.</li>
<li>Proven ability to support and execute marketing or engagement strategies that drive measurable client outcomes.</li>
<li>Passion for healthcare and supporting organizational change.</li>
<li>Collaborate with internal teams to deliver a seamless experience for clients, providing insights that inform product, process, or market improvements.</li>
<li>History of contributing to client retention, renewal management, and account growth opportunities.</li>
<li>Ability to build and maintain relationships with multiple stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance), navigating client environments effectively.</li>
<li>Experience partnering with Sales or Renewals teams to support commercial opportunities and account growth.</li>
<li>Strong interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and influence internal and external stakeholders.</li>
<li>Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.</li>
<li>Analytical skills and strategic thinking – able to translate data and client performance into actionable insights in collaboration with clients.</li>
<li>Experience supporting the full lifecycle of customer success post-sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management).</li>
<li>Comfort operating in a growing and evolving environment, adaptable to changing processes and ambiguity.</li>
<li>Willingness to travel occasionally (up to 20%) for client meetings and participate in our NYC office when needed.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Helpful experiences and skills (not required, can be learned on the job):</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a digital health company in health, wellness, or family health space.</li>
<li>Experience with managing high volume of clients is preferred</li>
<li>Experience supporting health benefit programs for employer or payer clients.</li>
<li>Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Looker, and Microsoft Office suite.</li>
</ul>
<p>The base salary range for this role is $106,000 - 120,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.</p>
<p><strong>New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)</strong>&nbsp;Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3>
<p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p><span class="s1"><span>Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands</span><strong><br><br>About the team</strong></span></p>
<p class="p2">Typeform is a leading provider of interactive forms, surveys, and data collection experiences. We help businesses create more engaging ways to collect, manage, and understand data.</p>
<p class="p2">This team sits at the center of how Typeform builds product experiences, creating the shared foundations, tooling, and infrastructure that support scalable and consistent development across the platform.</p>
<h2><span class="s1"><strong>About the role</strong></span></h2>
<p class="p2">We’re looking for a Mid level Full Stack Engineer with a stronger backend focus to help evolve the internal systems and infrastructure that support our product development ecosystem.</p>
<p class="p2">This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable internal platforms and developer tooling, while still being comfortable contributing across the frontend when needed. You’ll work on APIs, automation, release pipelines, and engineering infrastructure that improve how teams build and ship product experiences across Typeform.</p>
<p class="p2">You’ll partner closely with engineers and designers to improve tooling, workflows, and developer experience across the company.</p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> India (remote)
</p>

<h2><strong>Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision)</strong></h2>
<p>We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.</p>
<h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)</li>
<li>Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.</li>
<li>Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX</li>
<li>Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.</li>
<li>Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.</li>
<li>Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.</li>
<li>Fairness &amp; Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.</li>
<li>Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.</li>
<li>Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.</li>
<li>Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.</li>
<li>Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.</li>
<li>Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.</li>
<li>Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.</li>
<li>Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Jumio Values:</strong></p>
<p><span>IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation </span></p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong><span><strong>: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.</span></p>
<p><strong>About Jumio:</strong></p>
<p>Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.</p>
<p><strong>Applicant Data Privacy </strong></p>
<p>We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s <a href="https://www.jumio.com/legal-information/privacy-notices/candidate-notice/">Applicant Privacy Notice.</a> If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to <a href="mailto:privacy@jumio.com">privacy@jumio.com</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-machine-learning-engineer-iv-computer-vision">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-machine-learning-engineer-iv-computer-vision</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Abnormal: Director of Security Engineering</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>Abnormal AI protects organizations from the most sophisticated email and collaboration attacks using behavioral AI. Security is not a bolt-on at Abnormal; it is core to the product we sell and the trust our customers place in us. Our security organization operates a commercial cloud environment and a separate FedRAMP-authorized environment, and we are pursuing increasingly rigorous federal authorizations as we grow.</p>
<p>We are hiring a Director of Security reporting to the CISO and leading the Security Engineering organization. You will build and scale high-performing security teams, own major security programs end to end, and operate autonomously in the CISO's absence, including representing security to executive leadership, customers, and auditors.</p>
<p>This is a role for a deeply technical leader with a software engineering background who has grown into people leadership. You have built security teams from the ground up, you write and review code and architecture when it matters, and you believe the best security organizations earn their influence through partnership rather than policy enforcement.</p>
<h2>Our Security Philosophy</h2>
<p>We run security the way the best engineering-led companies do:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Security reduces toil.</strong> Our job is to make the rest of the company faster and safer at the same time. If a control adds friction without reducing risk, it is a defect.</li>
<li><strong>Paved paths, safe by default.</strong> We invest in guardrails, golden paths, and secure-by-default infrastructure so the easy choice is the secure choice. We prefer preventing classes of problems over chasing individual findings.</li>
<li><strong>Partnership over gatekeeping.</strong> Security succeeds only through deep collaboration with engineering, IT, and business teams. We embed with builders, we ship alongside them, and we take on their constraints as our own.</li>
<li><strong>Engineering-grade rigor.</strong> We treat security problems as engineering problems: automated, measurable, code-reviewed, and continuously improved.</li>
</ul>
<p>If the security cultures that value freedom and responsibility, context over control, and guardrails over gates resonate with you, you will feel at home here.</p>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Serve as deputy to the CISO: act with full authority in the CISO's absence and represent the security organization to executives, customers, and regulators.</li>
<li>Lead, coach, and grow managers and senior engineers across Security Engineering and Security Operations.</li>
<li>Own the security engineering roadmap: cloud security architecture (AWS-first), detection and response, identity, vulnerability management, and secure-by-default platform investments.</li>
<li>Drive cross-functional programs with Engineering, IT, and Product, from AI security governance to data perimeter controls to federal compliance initiatives.</li>
<li>Set and defend engineering standards for the security organization: everything as code, automated where possible, measured against outcomes rather than activity.</li>
<li>Build hiring pipelines and raise the bar on every hire; own performance management, promotion cases, and succession planning within your teams.</li>
<li>Translate technical risk into business terms for the executive team and board, and translate business priorities into a coherent security strategy.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Must Haves</h2>
<ul>
<li>10+ years in security or software engineering, including 4+ years managing security teams, ideally including managers of managers or equivalent scope.</li>
<li>A genuine software engineering background: you have shipped production software, and you evaluate security solutions the way an engineer would.</li>
<li>A proven record of building and scaling high-performing security teams, with alumni who would work for you again.</li>
<li>Deep technical fluency in cloud-native environments: AWS organizations and multi-account governance, Kubernetes, identity and access, detection engineering, and modern SDLC security.</li>
<li>Demonstrated cross-functional leadership: you have earned the trust of engineering leaders and shipped security outcomes through their teams, not around them.</li>
<li>Strong written communication: you produce decision-ready documents and can drive alignment asynchronously.</li>
<li>Executive presence: comfortable presenting to C-level leadership, customers, and auditors without preparation from the CISO.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Strong Signals</h2>
<ul>
<li>You are currently a security engineering manager or senior manager at a fintech, high-growth startup, or forward-leaning enterprise, and you are ready for broader scope.</li>
<li>You have built paved-path or secure-by-default platforms that measurably reduced both risk and developer friction.</li>
<li>Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) without letting compliance define the security program.</li>
<li>Experience securing AI/ML systems or governing AI adoption at scale.</li>
<li>You have operated in environments where security headcount was scarce and automation was the only way to scale.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Why This Role</h2>
<p>You will inherit strong teams, an executive staff that treats security as a first-class function, and a CISO who wants a true partner rather than a lieutenant. The scope is broad, the autonomy is real, and the ceiling on this role is defined by what you take on.</p>
<p>#LI-ML1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.<br>In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.</p></div><div class="title">Base salary range:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$214,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$308,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A note on AI in our process:&nbsp;<br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.</p>
<p>Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt9cbda641db7c0045/6a1e3d3a66aea075cd33e462/AAP_and_EEO_Statement.pdf"><span><em>click here</em></span></a>. If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please&nbsp;<em><span><a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt4eb3a265cc7b1ca9/6a1e3d3bfe33e73c16ff026b/EEOC_Know_Your_Rights_Oct_30_2025.pdf">click here</a></span></em>.</p></div>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
